newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 14.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's edition of Daily Variety:
NEW YORK - Westinghouse Electric Corp's spinoff of industrial assets will refocus the company on higher-growth businesses and could lead to strategic acquisitions in cable and other arenas.
HOLLYWOOD - The Motion Picture Association of America reiterated to the Federal Communications Commission its support for the controversial digital television standard
